description: Asking whether an app is properly code-signed and who signed it maps to security/verify_signature (codesign in verify mode), not gatekeeper_check (which answers 'would it be allowed to run'). Read-only; no confirmation.
prompt: Is /Applications/Safari.app properly code-signed, and who signed it? Has it been tampered with?

description: Asking whether macOS would let a downloaded app open — the Gatekeeper trust decision — maps to security/gatekeeper_check (spctl --assess), distinct from verify_signature (signature validity) and quarantine_info (download origin). Read-only assessment.
prompt: Would Gatekeeper let me open the app at ~/Downloads/SomeApp.app, or would it block it as untrusted?

description: Asking whether System Integrity Protection is enabled maps to security/sip_status (csrutil status), not a settings toggle or a system-info read. Read-only, fixed argv, no path input.
prompt: Is System Integrity Protection turned on on this Mac?
